title: Three-tag Praxis at 4446 forms with 15-position packing
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5584 MiB (5.4531 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 22932 million field multiplications (14591 and 8341), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
